snippet.title: Plume Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Plume is a roguelite that is coming to Steam in Q2 2027. You play as one of the survivors of a tribe of birds ravaged by a vulcano. Fight your way through procedurally generated levels. Gather and grow powerful items to create the ultimate build and rebuild your village to its former glory!

Wishlist now on Steam! First public playtest is also live!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4524430?utm_source=youtube

See our website!
https://coreplixstudios.co.uk/
